observations.question: According to the 2026 policy, what is the non-transport electric car scrapping incentive, applicant limit, price ceiling, old-car requirement, new-purchase deadline and who may receive it?

result.answer:
Delhi — source cutoff: 2026-09-23.

Prototype source review is pending; current availability and individual eligibility are not verified.

- Scrapping incentive amount for a non‑transport electric car is ₹1,00,000 per eligible applicant. [S8](https://transport.delhi.gov.in/sites/default/files/Transport/circulars-orders/delhi_ev_policy_2026-30_0.pdf#page=14)
- The incentive is limited to the first 100,000 eligible applicants under the policy. [S8](https://transport.delhi.gov.in/sites/default/files/Transport/circulars-orders/delhi_ev_policy_2026-30_0.pdf#page=14)
- Only new electric cars with an ex‑showroom price not exceeding ₹30 lakh are eligible for the incentive. [S8](https://transport.delhi.gov.in/sites/default/files/Transport/circulars-orders/delhi_ev_policy_2026-30_0.pdf#page=14)
- The scrapped vehicle must be a Delhi‑registered car of BS‑IV emission standard or older. [S8](https://transport.delhi.gov.in/sites/default/files/Transport/circulars-orders/delhi_ev_policy_2026-30_0.pdf#page=14)
- The purchase of the new electric car must occur within six (6) months of issuance of the Certificate of Deposit (CoD) from an authorised scrapping facility. [S8](https://transport.delhi.gov.in/sites/default/files/Transport/circulars-orders/delhi_ev_policy_2026-30_0.pdf#page=14) [S6](https://transport.delhi.gov.in/sites/default/files/Transport/circulars-orders/operating_guidelines.pdf#page=9)
- The incentive is payable to the owner of the scrapped vehicle who is a resident of NCT of Delhi and registers the new electric car in Delhi (individuals or eligible entities). [S8](https://transport.delhi.gov.in/sites/default/files/Transport/circulars-orders/delhi_ev_policy_2026-30_0.pdf#page=14) [S6](https://transport.delhi.gov.in/sites/default/files/Transport/circulars-orders/operating_guidelines.pdf#page=9)

Sources:

- [S8: Delhi — Delhi Electric Vehicle Policy 2026, PDF page 14](https://transport.delhi.gov.in/sites/default/files/Transport/circulars-orders/delhi_ev_policy_2026-30_0.pdf#page=14)
- [S6: Delhi — Centralized Operating Guidelines for Delhi EV Policy 2026, PDF page 9](https://transport.delhi.gov.in/sites/default/files/Transport/circulars-orders/operating_guidelines.pdf#page=9)

*No incentive shall be given to e-autos with battery capacity less than 4kWh. Incentive shall be applicable to
both plug-in and battery swapping e-three-wheelers models.
4.3.2 The incentive mentioned at 4.3.1 shall be applicable for the replacement of old CNG auto-rickshaws or purchase
of new electric-auto-rickshaws within the overall limit of auto-rickshaw fixed for NCT of Delhi.
4.4 Electric Four-Wheeler Goods Vehicles (N1)
4.4.1 Incentive Structure (Year-wise Registration):GNCTD shall provide the following incentive to promote e-
trucks (N1) adoption in NCT of Delhi:
Year of Registration Incentive
Year 1 from date of notification ₹ 1,00,000 for N1 >1.75-ton GVW and 50,000 upto 1.75 tons GVW
Year 2 from date of notification ₹ 75,000 for N1 >1.75-ton GVW and 37,500 upto 1.75 tons GVW
Year 3 from date of notification ₹ 50,000 for N1 >1.75-ton GVW and 25,000 upto 1.75 tons GVW

4.5 The eligibility of EV models for purchase incentives shall be aligned to FAME 2, PM E-DRIVE scheme, and other
schemes/guidelines of Government of India or GNCTD, if any.
4.6 Scrapping Incentives
4.6.1 Electric Two-Wheeler: A scrapping incentive of ₹10,000 shall be provided upon purc hase of a new electric vehicle
under this policy, provided the purchase is made within six (6) months of issuance of the Certificate of Deposit (CoD)
from an authorised scrapping facility. This incentive shall be applicable for scrapping of Delhi registered BS-IV and
below, two-wheelers.
4.6.2 Electric Three-Wheeler (L5M): A scrapping incentive of ₹25,000 shall be provided upon purchase of a new electric
vehicle under this policy, provided the purchase is made within six (6) months of issuance of the Certificate of Deposit
(CoD) from an authorised scrapping facility. This incentive shall be applicable for scrapping of Delhi registered BS-IV
and below, three-wheelers (L5M).
4.6.3Electric Car (Non-Transport):A scrapping incentive of ₹1,00,000 shall be provided upon purchase of a new
electric car under this policy, subject to an ex-showroom price not exceeding ₹30 lakh , provided the purchase is made
within six (6) months of issuance of the Certificate of Deposit (CoD) from an authorised scrapping facility. This
incentive shall be applicable for the scrapping of Delhi-registered BS-IV and below carsand shall belimited to the
first 1,00,000 eligible applicants under this policy.
4.6.4Electric Four-Wheeler Goods Carriers (N1 Trucks):A scrapping incentive of ₹50,000 shall be provided upon
purchase of a new electric vehicle under this policy, provided the purchase is made within six (6) months of issuance of
the Certificate of Deposit (CoD) from an authorised scrapping facility. This incentive shall be applicable for scrapping
of Delhi registered BS-IV and below, four-wheeler Goods Carriers (N1 Trucks).
4.6.5 A scrapping incentive of ₹15,000 shall be provided upo n scrapping of a Gramin Sewa vehicle registered in Delhi,
subject to the condition that a new electric Gramin Sewa vehicle (D+6/D+7) equipped with a Li-ion battery or any other
advanced/progressive battery technology is purchased within six months from the date of issuance of the Certificate of
Deposit (CoD) by an authorised scrapping facility.
4.6.6 All scrapping incentive shall be disbursed through direct benefit transfer to individual buyer/ proprietary
firms/ agencies/ companies being residents of NCT of Delhi and the vehicle being registered in Delhi. Eligible
beneficiaries shall apply directly for subsidy claims through a mechanism notified by the Transport Department,
GNCTD.
4.6.7 All scrapping incentive on CoD shall be applicable only to the owner of the scrapped vehicle.
4.7 Road Tax, Registration Fee Exemption and No Entry Exemption
4.7.1 All electric vehicles (subject to clause 4.7.2, and 4.7.3) purchased and registered in the NCT of Delhi during the
policy period shall be granted 100% exemption from road tax throughout the life of the vehicle and registration fees at
the time of vehicle registration.
4.7.2 All electric cars with ex-showroom price below or equal to 30 lakhs purchased and registered in the NCT of Delhi
shall be granted 100% exemption from road tax and registration fees till 31 March 2030.
4.7.3 All electric cars with ex-showroom price above 30 lakhs purchased and registered in the NCT of Delhi shall not
be granted any exemption from road tax and registration fees.

20.2. The applicant shall purchase a new eligible electric vehicle within six (6) months 
from the date of issuance of the Certificate of Deposit (CoD) by an Authorised 
Vehicle Scrapping Facility, wherever applicable under the Policy. 
20.3. The scrapping incentive shall be available only to the owner of the scrapped vehicle in 
whose favour the Certificate of Deposit (CoD) has been issued. 
21. Submission of Application 
21.1. Applicants shall submit an application for scrapping incentive through the designated 
portal, accompanied by the Certificate of Deposit (CoD) and the documents 
prescribed under these Guidelines. 
21.2. Individual applicants shall be eligible to claim scrapping incentives only in respect of 
vehicle categories covered under the Delhi Electric Vehicle Policy, 2026, subject to 
fulfilment of the residency and other eligibility conditions prescribed under Annexure 
XI. 
21.3. Companies, firms and other entities shall be eligible to claim scrapping incentives in 
respect of vehicles registered in their name, subject to fulfilment of the eligibility 
conditions prescribed under Annexure XI, including proof that the registered office of 
the applicant is situated in the National Capital Territory of Delhi. 
22. Verification and Disbursal 
22.1. Upon receipt of an application, the concerned DTO shall scrutinise and verify the 
application and supporting documents in accordance with Annexure XII. 
22.2. Where the application is incomplete or requires clarification, the deficiencies shall be 
communicated to the applicant through the designated portal within fifteen (15) 
working days from the date of receipt of the application. 
22.3. The applicant shall rectify the deficiencies and submit the required information or 
documents within seven (7) working days from the date of communication of such 
deficiencies. 
22.4. Upon receipt of a complete application or the information furnished under Clause 
22.3, the DTO shall complete the verification and communicate the decision on the 
application within seven (7) working days. 
22.5. The scrapping incentive shall be disbursed within the timeline prescribed under the 
Delhi Electric Vehicle Policy, 2026, subject to verification and fulfilment of the 
applicable requirements. 
22.6. The status of the application, including any deficiencies, approval, rejection or 
disbursal of incentive, shall be communicated to the applicant through the designated 
portal and through SMS alerts on the registered mobile number of the applicant.

4.4.1 Incentive Structure (Year-wise Registration):GNCTD shall provide the following incentive to promote e-
trucks (N1) adoption in NCT of Delhi:
Year of Registration Incentive
Year 1 from date of notification ₹ 1,00,000 for N1 >1.75-ton GVW and 50,000 upto 1.75 tons GVW
Year 2 from date of notification ₹ 75,000 for N1 >1.75-ton GVW and 37,500 upto 1.75 tons GVW
Year 3 from date of notification ₹ 50,000 for N1 >1.75-ton GVW and 25,000 upto 1.75 tons GVW

4.5 The eligibility of EV models for purchase incentives shall be aligned to FAME 2, PM E-DRIVE scheme, and other
schemes/guidelines of Government of India or GNCTD, if any.
4.6 Scrapping Incentives
4.6.1 Electric Two-Wheeler: A scrapping incentive of ₹10,000 shall be provided upon purc hase of a new electric vehicle
under this policy, provided the purchase is made within six (6) months of issuance of the Certificate of Deposit (CoD)
from an authorised scrapping facility. This incentive shall be applicable for scrapping of Delhi registered BS-IV and
below, two-wheelers.
4.6.2 Electric Three-Wheeler (L5M): A scrapping incentive of ₹25,000 shall be provided upon purchase of a new electric
vehicle under this policy, provided the purchase is made within six (6) months of issuance of the Certificate of Deposit
(CoD) from an authorised scrapping facility. This incentive shall be applicable for scrapping of Delhi registered BS-IV
and below, three-wheelers (L5M).
4.6.3Electric Car (Non-Transport):A scrapping incentive of ₹1,00,000 shall be provided upon purchase of a new
electric car under this policy, subject to an ex-showroom price not exceeding ₹30 lakh , provided the purchase is made
within six (6) months of issuance of the Certificate of Deposit (CoD) from an authorised scrapping facility. This
incentive shall be applicable for the scrapping of Delhi-registered BS-IV and below carsand shall belimited to the
first 1,00,000 eligible applicants under this policy.
4.6.4Electric Four-Wheeler Goods Carriers (N1 Trucks):A scrapping incentive of ₹50,000 shall be provided upon
purchase of a new electric vehicle under this policy, provided the purchase is made within six (6) months of issuance of
the Certificate of Deposit (CoD) from an authorised scrapping facility. This incentive shall be applicable for scrapping
of Delhi registered BS-IV and below, four-wheeler Goods Carriers (N1 Trucks).
4.6.5 A scrapping incentive of ₹15,000 shall be provided upo n scrapping of a Gramin Sewa vehicle registered in Delhi,
subject to the condition that a new electric Gramin Sewa vehicle (D+6/D+7) equipped with a Li-ion battery or any other
advanced/progressive battery technology is purchased within six months from the date of issuance of the Certificate of
Deposit (CoD) by an authorised scrapping facility.
4.6.6 All scrapping incentive shall be disbursed through direct benefit transfer to individual buyer/ proprietary
firms/ agencies/ companies being residents of NCT of Delhi and the vehicle being registered in Delhi. Eligible
beneficiaries shall apply directly for subsidy claims through a mechanism notified by the Transport Department,
GNCTD.
4.6.7 All scrapping incentive on CoD shall be applicable only to the owner of the scrapped vehicle.
4.7 Road Tax, Registration Fee Exemption and No Entry Exemption
4.7.1 All electric vehicles (subject to clause 4.7.2, and 4.7.3) purchased and registered in the NCT of Delhi during the
policy period shall be granted 100% exemption from road tax throughout the life of the vehicle and registration fees at
the time of vehicle registration.
4.7.2 All electric cars with ex-showroom price below or equal to 30 lakhs purchased and registered in the NCT of Delhi
shall be granted 100% exemption from road tax and registration fees till 31 March 2030.
4.7.3 All electric cars with ex-showroom price above 30 lakhs purchased and registered in the NCT of Delhi shall not
be granted any exemption from road tax and registration fees.

20.2. The applicant shall purchase a new eligible electric vehicle within six (6) months 
from the date of issuance of the Certificate of Deposit (CoD) by an Authorised 
Vehicle Scrapping Facility, wherever applicable under the Policy. 
20.3. The scrapping incentive shall be available only to the owner of the scrapped vehicle in 
whose favour the Certificate of Deposit (CoD) has been issued. 
21. Submission of Application 
21.1. Applicants shall submit an application for scrapping incentive through the designated 
portal, accompanied by the Certificate of Deposit (CoD) and the documents 
prescribed under these Guidelines. 
21.2. Individual applicants shall be eligible to claim scrapping incentives only in respect of 
vehicle categories covered under the Delhi Electric Vehicle Policy, 2026, subject to 
fulfilment of the residency and other eligibility conditions prescribed under Annexure 
XI. 
21.3. Companies, firms and other entities shall be eligible to claim scrapping incentives in 
respect of vehicles registered in their name, subject to fulfilment of the eligibility 
conditions prescribed under Annexure XI, including proof that the registered office of 
the applicant is situated in the National Capital Territory of Delhi. 
22. Verification and Disbursal 
22.1. Upon receipt of an application, the concerned DTO shall scrutinise and verify the 
application and supporting documents in accordance with Annexure XII. 
22.2. Where the application is incomplete or requires clarification, the deficiencies shall be 
communicated to the applicant through the designated portal within fifteen (15) 
working days from the date of receipt of the application. 
22.3. The applicant shall rectify the deficiencies and submit the required information or 
documents within seven (7) working days from the date of communication of such 
deficiencies. 
22.4. Upon receipt of a complete application or the information furnished under Clause 
22.3, the DTO shall complete the verification and communicate the decision on the 
application within seven (7) working days. 
22.5. The scrapping incentive shall be disbursed within the timeline prescribed under the 
Delhi Electric Vehicle Policy, 2026, subject to verification and fulfilment of the 
applicable requirements. 
22.6. The status of the application, including any deficiencies, approval, rejection or 
disbursal of incentive, shall be communicated to the applicant through the designated 
portal and through SMS alerts on the registered mobile number of the applicant.
